tasks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone language selection icon for GELITA mobile game UI. Reference image is ONLY a reference for the circular navy and antique gold HUD rim, materials and restrained bevel. Create a single perfectly round front-facing 3D UI medallion on genuine transparent background, target design 256x256. A slender antique-gold raised rim surrounds a midnight navy recessed face. Inside is a large flat enamel national flag with subtly rounded rectangular corners, centred, crisp and easy to recognize at 32px. Keep the flag large (about 70% of disc diameter wide) and its flag colours faithful, not tinted gold. Rim and silhouette should match the reference; controlled top-left highlight and very small shadow. No pole, waving cloth, text, letters, country name, ID, EN, extra symbols, landscape, character, watermark, extra medallions or UI kit sheet. Entire rim visible, small transparent padding only. Flag: Indonesia, precisely two equal horizontal bands, RED top (#E32219) and WHITE bottom, rectangular ratio 3:2. No blue, no emblem, no extra bands. The flag is fully visible and not clipped by the rim.
